pages.title: Speed Boat
pages.text: The speed boat is an aluminium motor boat that is much faster than a wooden one. Use it on water to put it down, use the boat to climb in, and hit it to pick it back up. It steers like a horse: it goes where you look, and strafing turns it sideways.

It speeds up the longer you drive, up to about seven blocks a second. It floats back up when it sinks, runs over lily pads (breaking them), hurts any squid in its way badly and shoves wooden boats aside. An empty speed boat stops dead.
